scripts.build: npm run build:learn && npm run build:blog && npm run build:home
scripts.check: (cd learn && astro check) && (cd blog && astro check) && (cd home && astro check)

scripts.dev:cathy: node cathy/e2e/local-config.mjs && wrangler dev -c admin/wrangler.jsonc -c cathy/worker/wrangler.local.jsonc -c share/wrangler.jsonc -c money/wrangler.jsonc --var ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN: --var ACCESS_AUD:
